maturity: The real-provider Copilot, durable Trip completion, signed anonymous identity, cost and product-event persistence, three-turn and trusted-IP guards, truthful request states, controlled-preview Human Tasks, legal pages, retention enforcement, durable outbound ledger, Admin-only partner configuration, P0-19 telemetry, and P0-20 public-runtime controls are merged. P0-20 preserves the existing anonymous and trusted-network guards, bounds Copilot input/output, adds the authenticated HMAC-keyed Upstash window and per-identity China-day Human Help cap, keeps daily cost observation non-blocking, and provides truthful recovery with safe correlation-only route logs. Execution-fact safety has a reviewed safe-phrase schema, fail-closed model bypass/grounding guard, and blocking runtime evals. The mandatory deterministic policy-eval suite now covers commerce intent, review-only Human Help handoff, invalid TripPatch rejection, insufficient-knowledge honesty, and medical/legal fixed-expression paths. Local-address facts, legacy-address quarantine, deterministic POI alias resolution, and the no-fallback presentation guard are also merged. VisePod has the accepted HTTPS Device Protocol v1 plus a draft Studio provisioning contract and pure domain schemas only; no Studio route, token issuer, binding table, device registry, gateway, or firmware runtime exists. ADR-0015 and ADR-0016 are Accepted; ADR-0017 remains Draft. No partner is active, no booking or commission is promised, no payment is live, and Phase 1 through Phase 4 remain trigger-gated.
